chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Hunts Evil Loose Immortals & Uncovers the Quya Mountains Treasure – Desolate Era Chapter 383
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning discovers a treasure map linking the Twelve Eastern Flow Demon Kings, tests the Qi prince and finds him wanting, then hunts down a six-hundred-thousand-year-old evil Loose Immortal to upgrade his swords.
og_description: Ji Ning deciphers the demon kings’ secret, fails a princeling, and kills an ancient evil to power up before the Quya Mountains.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s New Quest: The Quya Mountains Treasure
twitter_description: Ji Ning analyzes the demon kings’ identical maps, rejects a greedy prince, and gains a power boost from slaying an ancient evil.

lore_anchors.definition: A dangerous, mist-shrouded mountain range in the Crescent Major World; the site of a secret treasure ground that the Qi Kingdom’s royal clan plundered for generations, built on fragments of the primordial Pangu’s World.

A group of twelve powerful demon kings in the Crescent Major World, formerly known for dominating the Eastern Flow region; eight were slain by Ji Ning, one he killed later, and the others fled or survived.
The leader of the Twelve Eastern Flow Demon Kings; slain by Ji Ning. His ancient treasure map and journal revealed the secret of the Quya Mountains.
The fourth-ranked of the Twelve Eastern Flow Demon Kings; survived the initial massacre but was later hunted down and killed by Ji Ning for his karmic sin.
The prince of the Qi Kingdom, whose hesitation to share his clan’s treasure map led to Ji Ning rejecting him as a disciple.
The major world created by Patriarch Subhuti, containing fragments of the shattered primordial Pangu’s World; a vast, hidden treasure ground for the Patriarch’s disciples.
Heavy negative karma accumulated by a cultivator through mass murder or evil deeds; hunting those with great karmic sin can provide both karmic merit and potent killing intent for weapon refinement.
A six-hundred-thousand-year-old human Loose Immortal and the strongest of an evil sect; slain by Ji Ning in a protracted battle, yielding massive killing intent for his Northsea swords.
Ji Ning’s three bonded flying swords, upgraded to the equivalent of high-grade Immortal-ranked flying swords after absorbing the killing intent from the nine demon kings and the evil patriarch.
